newsitem.title: USA: Miami's AIBC Investment merges with broker-dealer.
newsitem.headline: Miami's AIBC Investment merges with broker-dealer.

text.p: AIBC Investment Services Corp and American Government Certificates & Funds Corp expect to complete a merger in about a month, company officials said on Monday.

American Government Certificates is a broker-dealer headquartered in Miami. AIBC, also headquartered in Miami, is a dealer and underwriter and is also a member of the pool of minority-owned firms certified to underwrite Dade County issues of up to $50 million.

AIBC Chairman Wilfredo Gort and American Government President Maria Melendez-Enriquez notified the county's Finance and Trust Funds Committee of the pending merger on Monday and sought permission for the new entity to remain in the underwriting pool.
Assistant County Attorney Gerald Heffernan indicated permission would probably be forthcoming.

After the meeting, Gort and Melendez-Enriquez said the merger was still pending regulatory approval. The configuration of the new company has not been decided, but American Government will probably become a unit of AIBC, they said. Gort said capitalization figures were not final, although the new firm "will be very well capitalized."
"We'll still be based in Miami. We'll still be a minority-owned firm. We'll go from 52 percent to 100 percent (minority owned)," Gort told Reuters.
